svg.title: NEMA — review study
svg.desc: Corrected square study perimeter to rounded single receptacle face and polarized slot proportions seen in thumbnail. NEMA 5-15R family example, not a claim that generic NEMA means this subtype. No exposed copper contacts. Original WireNexus thumbnail compared visually; existing SVG inspected at 32, 64 and 128 px. 5-15R-style polarized 2-slot + ground face checked as a family example. NEMA is a generic inventory label. Source resembles 5-15R but exact subtype/SKU is not established; do not use artwork to assert electrical compatibility.
